description: This source file defines a PHP class 'Register' within the OpenCart e-commerce framework, responsible for handling registration email notifications and alerts. It contains methods to generate registration emails, send alerts to administrators, and interface with system models for task management and configuration.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: Handles email notifications for user registration and alerts for administrators within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares and sends a registration email to the new user, including details about store name, customer group, and login URL. It creates a task for email delivery via system scheduler.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Sends alert notifications to configured administrator emails about a new customer registration, including customer details and additional email alerting.
